faq_introduction: Find answers to common questions about BescheidBuddy's document analysis service.
faq_1_question: What types of documents can I analyze with BescheidBuddy?
faq_1_answer: BescheidBuddy can analyze official letters and documents from German authorities such as the job center, tax office, health insurance companies, pension funds, and other government agencies. The system is optimized for typical German administrative correspondence.
faq_2_question: How accurate is the AI analysis?
faq_2_answer: Our AI provides highly accurate analyses of standard administrative documents. However, the accuracy may vary for very specialized or unusual cases. Always review the generated explanation carefully, especially for legally binding decisions.
faq_3_question: Is my data secure and private?
faq_3_answer: Yes, data security is our top priority. All documents are transmitted using end-to-end encryption, processed securely, and stored only for a limited time necessary for the analysis. We do not share your data with third parties.
faq_4_question: How long does the analysis take?
faq_4_answer: Most documents are analyzed within seconds to a few minutes, depending on the length and complexity of the document. You'll receive your explanation and response template immediately after processing.
faq_5_answer: No, BescheidBuddy is a technical service for document analysis and does not constitute legal advice. For legally binding situations, complex cases, or appeals, we strongly recommend consulting a qualified lawyer or professional advisor.
faq_6_answer: Currently, BescheidBuddy supports English, German, Russian, Ukrainian, and Polish. We're continuously working to add more languages to better serve our diverse user base.
faq_7_question: What happens to my documents after analysis?
faq_7_answer: Documents are automatically deleted after a limited storage period (typically 30 days) for security reasons. You can also manually delete your documents at any time. We recommend saving important explanations locally.
faq_8_answer: BescheidBuddy offers a free trial to test the service. After that, we provide flexible pricing plans based on your usage needs. Check our pricing page for current plans and rates.
faq_9_question: Can I edit the generated response templates?
faq_9_answer: Yes, all response templates are fully editable. We provide them as a starting point that you can customize according to your specific situation and needs.
faq_10_question: What should I do if the analysis seems incorrect?
faq_10_answer: If you notice any errors or have concerns about the analysis, please contact our support team. While our AI is highly accurate, no system is perfect. We continuously improve our algorithms based on user feedback.
